title: Cardinality of monomial exponent vectors
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty set. Write $\mathcal M(I)$ for the monomial exponent set of the polynomial-ring definition [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], namely the set of maps $e:I\to\mathbf N$ with finite support, meaning that $\{i\in I:e(i)\ne0\}$ is finite. Then $|\mathcal M(I)|=\max(|I|,\aleph_0)$. In particular, if $I$ is infinite, $|\mathcal M(I)|=|I|$. Cardinal comparisons are taken in a common universe.
